items.prompt: Your friend asks how you feel about the job interview tomorrow. Which reply fits best?
options: I've prepared what I can; I'll see how it goes.
I keep picturing my mind going blank in front of them.
items.target: I keep picturing my mind going blank in front of them.

items.prompt: Your partner is an hour late and hasn't called. Your mother texts to ask if you're coming over. Which reply fits best?
options: Not yet, Sam's an hour late. I'll come over once he's back home.
Not yet, Sam's an hour late and not answering. What if something's happened?
items.target: Not yet, Sam's an hour late and not answering. What if something's happened?

items.prompt: A colleague asks about your medical test results. Which reply fits best?
options: They're due Friday. Nothing to do until then but wait.
They're due Friday, and I can't stop imagining the worst.
items.target: They're due Friday, and I can't stop imagining the worst.

items.prompt: Your teenager is going to their first festival alone. Which reply fits best?
options: Have a good time, but text me every hour, and stay with friends.
Have a brilliant time, love, and dance till your feet hurt!
items.target: Have a good time, but text me every hour, and stay with friends.

items.prompt: Your boss asks to see you at four with no explanation. A coworker asks if you know why. Which reply fits best?
options: No idea, and it's all I can think about. Am I in trouble?
No idea. I'll find out at four, I suppose. Back soon.
items.target: No idea, and it's all I can think about. Am I in trouble?

items.prompt: A friend asks if you're looking forward to the flight. Which reply fits best?
options: Not really. I keep picturing turbulence and checking the forecast.
Can't wait to get going, I've packed and I'm ready to roll!
items.target: Not really. I keep picturing turbulence and checking the forecast.

items.prompt: Your neighbour asks about the noise you heard downstairs last night. Which reply fits best?
options: I lay awake listening for it again, my heart pounding.
I lay awake for hours. Whoever it was, I'm sick of it.
items.target: I lay awake listening for it again, my heart pounding.

items.prompt: Your sister asks how the new baby is sleeping. Which reply fits best?
options: In little bursts. I watch her breathe and just melt.
In little bursts. I keep checking she's still breathing.
items.target: In little bursts. I keep checking she's still breathing.

items.prompt: A friend asks how you feel about the exam results coming out tomorrow. Which reply fits best?
options: Sick to my stomach. What if I've failed everything?
Ready enough. Whatever they say, I'll handle it.
items.target: Sick to my stomach. What if I've failed everything?

items.prompt: Your manager asks if the release is ready for tomorrow. Which reply fits best?
options: It's ready. We ran the checks this afternoon, all passing.
It's ready, I think, but I've rerun the checks four times.
items.target: It's ready, I think, but I've rerun the checks four times.

items.prompt: Your partner asks why you've checked the front door twice. Which reply fits best?
options: I wanted to be sure it was locked before we went to bed.
I just need to be sure it's locked. Something feels off tonight.
items.target: I just need to be sure it's locked. Something feels off tonight.

items.prompt: A friend asks about the hiking trip in the mountains next week. Which reply fits best?
options: It's going to be amazing, I can't stop smiling about it!
What if the weather turns and we get stuck up there?
items.target: What if the weather turns and we get stuck up there?

items.prompt: Your landlord emails asking to inspect the flat on Monday. Your flatmate asks what you think. Which reply fits best?
options: Why so suddenly? Do you think he's going to evict us?
Fine by me. We'll tidy up on Sunday and that's that.
items.target: Why so suddenly? Do you think he's going to evict us?

items.prompt: A colleague asks how your first day as team lead went. Which reply fits best?
options: Tense. I kept wondering if they'd see I don't know what I'm doing.
Lonely. Nobody really talked to me, and I felt out of place there.
items.target: Tense. I kept wondering if they'd see I don't know what I'm doing.

items.prompt: Your child's school calls and asks you to ring back. Your partner asks what it's about. Which reply fits best?
options: They didn't say. My heart's racing, what if she's hurt?
They didn't say. I'll ring back after this meeting ends.
items.target: They didn't say. My heart's racing, what if she's hurt?

items.prompt: A friend asks how the house sale is going. Which reply fits best?
options: The buyer keeps stalling, and frankly I'm sick of his games.
The buyer keeps stalling, and I'm terrified it'll fall through.
items.target: The buyer keeps stalling, and I'm terrified it'll fall through.
